text.title: State machines
text.intro: Session states come from polling Claude's session files every 2 seconds, or `claude agents --json --all` every 4 seconds or slower when the files are unusable; tab and PR states are derived from probes and git.
text.machine tab-load: loading phase of an embedded editor tab
text.state tab-load connecting: waiting for the VS Code server to answer
text.state tab-load downloading: serve-web is fetching a matching server build
text.state tab-load ready: the Monaco workbench is on screen
text.state tab-load failed: a phase timed out; the user can retry
text.tr tab-load connecting downloading: page probe sees the download placeholder
text.tr tab-load ready connecting: the live editor navigates away, restarting the watch
text.machine pr: a pull request's state, derived from git on each scan, never stored
text.state pr open: its branch still exists on origin and is not merged
text.state pr merged: the merge or its head commit is reachable from the base branch or the default branch
text.state pr closed: declined: not merged and its branch is gone from origin
text.state pr declined: the host says the PR was declined or superseded while its branch still exists on origin
text.tr pr open declined: Bitbucket answers DECLINED or SUPERSEDED for a PR that git still reads as open
text.tr pr open merged: the base or default branch now contains the PR
text.tr pr open closed: the branch is deleted from origin without a merge
text.machine session: a Claude Code session's state in the project list, replaced wholesale by each successful poll
text.state session running: Claude is working: a busy interactive process or a working background session
text.state session done: a turn finished (idle interactive process or done background session); notifies once when observed after running, and again when a newer change time shows another turn finished between two polls
text.state session shell: a turn finished but a background shell (dev server, watcher) is still alive; notifies once as finished and counts as needing attention
text.state session permission: waiting on a permission prompt or sandbox request; notifies once when observed
text.state session idle: waiting for the user's input or another reason; notifies once when observed
text.state session failed: a background session failed; notifies once when observed after running, and stays as needing attention until cleared
text.state session stopped: a background session was stopped; shown as needing attention until cleared
text.state session unknown: the row carries no usable state; never notifies on its next change
text.state session unavailable: the last poll failed, so all sessions show an unknown status until one succeeds
text.tr session running shell: poll reports a finished turn with a background shell still alive
text.tr session shell done: poll reports the background shell ended; quiet, not a second finish
text.tr session shell running: poll reports the session working again
text.tr session running permission: poll reports a permission prompt or sandbox request
text.tr session running idle: poll reports a wait for input
text.tr session running failed: poll reports the background session failed
text.tr session running stopped: poll reports the background session stopped
text.tr session done running: poll reports the session working again
text.tr session permission running: poll reports the session working again
text.tr session idle running: poll reports the session working again
text.tr session unknown running: poll reports a usable state for the first time
text.tr session running unavailable: the poll fails, times out or returns invalid output
text.tr session done unavailable: the poll fails, times out or returns invalid output
text.tr session shell unavailable: the poll fails, times out or returns invalid output
text.tr session permission unavailable: the poll fails, times out or returns invalid output
text.tr session idle unavailable: the poll fails, times out or returns invalid output
